assumptions.choice: On entry fill, submit a stop order at entry_price - 2*ATR(14) for longs (entry_price + 2*ATR(14) for shorts), using ATR(14) evaluated at the entry-fill bar as a static (non-trailing) offset.
assumptions.reason: Spec states 'a protective stop-loss based on ATR(14) multiplied by 2' but does not specify the triggering mechanism or whether it re-evaluates over time; a stop order at a fixed ATR-based offset from entry is the literal, standard reading.

assumptions.choice: Exit long when close >= middle band; exit short when close <= middle band (i.e., price moving from its entry side back to the mean).
assumptions.reason: Spec says 'exit positions when price reaches the middle Bollinger Band' without specifying direction; since longs enter at/below the lower band and shorts enter at/above the upper band, 'reaching' the middle band means closing the gap toward the mean.

assumptions.choice: When the middle-band exit condition triggers, any pending ATR stop order is canceled, and vice versa (the stop order firing clears the middle-band exit path).
assumptions.reason: Spec does not address exit-order precedence when the two exit conditions could both apply; only one exit should close the single open position (canonical default #3).
Spec is silent on sizing; canonical default #1.

assumptions.choice: No new entries while an entry, exit, or stop order is pending, or while a position is open.
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent; canonical default #3 (hold at most one position at a time).
